Seoul.fact: Seoul is the capital and largest city of South Korea.

Geneva.fact: Geneva is known internationally for finance and diplomacy.

Tokyo.fact: Tokyo is Japan’s capital and most populous city.

Manila.fact: Manila is the capital city of the Philippines.

Paris.fact: Paris is nicknamed the “City of Light.”

Belgrade.fact: Belgrade is the capital and largest city of Serbia.

Davao.fact: Davao City is nicknamed the “Durian Capital of the Philippines.”
